name: Spherical Dimension of Tagged Singletons
details: For $n\geq5$, so that the construction has at least three tag coordinates.
proof: Projection to any three tag coordinates is the class of three singletons together with the empty concept, whose spherical dimension is one. Projection monotonicity therefore gives $\mathrm{sd}\geq1$. The recorded VC dimension is one, and the low-VC classification in the cited paper gives $\mathrm{sd}\leq1$.
